offering_description.value: The company sells secondhand clothing, accessories, and household goods to consumers through its thrift stores. It buys inventory from local nonprofits and runs a recycling and reuse program.

quotes.quote: With multiple thrift stores in the U.S., Canada, and Australia you're sure to find great deals on clothing, accessories, hard goods, electronics, books, home goods, and more.

We’ve chosen to keep our business model this way—to buy our supply from local nonprofits. But we didn’t stop there. We’ve also created a leading recycling and reuse program, where we keep millions of pounds of reusable items out of area landfills every year.
